note: Entries here are legitimately-independent own-definitions that detectDuplicateSymbols would otherwise flag as TRUE_DUPLICATE. Matched by (name, file) — `names` supports a trailing '*' wildcard or exact literal '*' for match-all; `filesGlob` supports a trailing '/**' prefix match or an exact repo-relative file path. A duplicate name is only fully explained away (tag ALLOWLISTED) when ALL of its non-alias-delegation, non-dispatch-variant definers match an entry here.
